It holds: account_scope_id, symbol, quantity (>0 for long), avg_entry_price, market_value (optional), cost_basis, management (MANAGED/UNMANAGED/ADOPTED; positions observed externally default to UNMANAGED), cycle_id (optional, required when MANAGED), and as_of.\n- `BudgetPolicy` holds: per_symbol_budget, total_application_budget (>= per_symbol), max_open_positions (int >= 1), planned_loss_per_trade (optional), daily_loss_limit (optional), and require_broker_buying_power (default True).\n- `EntryEligibilityPolicy` holds: max_filled_entry_cycles_per_symbol_per_session (int >= 1), consecutive_loss_lockout_threshold (optional int), lockout_scope_by_strategy (bool), post_sale_cooldown (timedelta >= 0), min_hold_for_strategy_exit (timedelta >= 0, applying only to STRATEGY_EXIT and never to stops, manual closes, or safety exits), and entry_kill_switch (bool).\n- `EntryEligibilityState` holds: account_scope_id, symbol, session_date, filled_entry_cycles, consecutive_losses, last_exit_at, locked_until (optional), and block_reasons. Add a method `entry_blocked(now) -> tuple[str, ...]`. Entry blocks never affect exit eligibility, and a helper `exit_allowed(purpose, held_for)` must return True for PROTECTIVE_STOP/MANUAL_CLOSE/SAFETY_EXIT/EOD_CLOSE regardless of min hold.\n\nmike_trade/domain/protection.py:\n- `ProtectionKind` enum: FIXED_STOP, BROKER_TRAILING_STOP, STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP.\n- `ProtectionStatus` enum: PENDING, ACTIVE, REPLACING, UNKNOWN, CANCELED, TRIGGERED, UNSUPPORTED.\n- `ProtectionPolicy` holds: kind, stop_offset_percent or stop_offset_amount for fixed stops, trail_percent or trail_amount for trailing kinds, step_size and activation_gain for stepped, and require_broker_held (default True), with kind-specific validation.\n- `TrailingStopState` holds: cycle_id, account_scope_id, symbol, kind, status, covered_quantity (>0), stop_price, high_water_mark, broker_order_id (optional), and last_confirmed_at (optional UTC).\n- Pure methods:\n  - `ratchet(new_stop_price, observed_high)` never lowers stop_price for a long and raises on a downward move.\n  - `with_covered_quantity(remaining)` resizes coverage to the actual remaining quantity and rejects coverage greater than remaining.\n  - `start_protection(policy, cycle, fill_price)` is a classmethod or function that raises unless the cycle has positive filled entry quantity.\n- Add `combined_sell_exposure(protective_qty, pending_exit_qty, position_qty) -> bool`, which reports whether overlapping sells could exceed the position and create a short.\n\ntests/contracts/test_trading_contracts.py should hold positive and negative tests for all invariants above. Cover at least: partial entry fills accepted; second entry after exit start rejected; over-exit rejected; CLOSED after full exit; realized P&L with fees; short-entry intent rejected; quantity/notional exclusivity; filled_quantity bound; UNMANAGED default for external positions; min-hold exempting protective/manual/safety exits; stop never moving downward; coverage resized to remaining quantity; protection refused before a positive fill; and the overlapping-sell detection.\n\nDecision budget: make at most four design choices not covered here, and record them in the module docstrings.\n\nBefore editing, inspect:\n- mike_trade/domain/errors.py (read-only), including EntryBlockedError and UnsupportedOrderCapabilityError\n- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (read-only, if present)\n- pyproject.toml (read-only) for pytest/mypy settings",
.abracapocus/plans/ACTIVE/MIKE_TRADE_COMPLETE_PRODUCT/e/task_e.4_implement_alpaca_activity_and_trade_update_stream_normalization.json:7:  "description": "Implement broker activity ingestion and trade_updates stream normalization.\n\nmike_trade/brokers/alpaca/activities.py:\n(1) Query GET /v2/account/activities, by type and with date/after/until filters, through the e.1 client. Paginate using page_token and page_size with a hard maximum page count so reads are bounded.\n(2) Normalize FILL activities: id, order_id, symbol, side, qty, cum_qty, leaves_qty, price, transaction_time in UTC, and type (fill or partial_fill). Normalize non-trade activities where present, such as fees (FEE, CFEE, PTC, and TAF-related where reported), dividends, and corporate actions (SPLIT, SPIN, MA, NC, and similar). All amounts are Decimal.\n(3) Each normalized activity has a stable idempotency key, the broker activity id plus environment/account fingerprint, so repeated ingestion of the same activity is detectable and can be deduplicated downstream. Provide a pure dedupe helper.\n(4) Unknown activity types are preserved as a raw, typed UnknownActivity rather than dropped or crashing.\n\nmike_trade/brokers/alpaca/updates.py:\n(1) Normalize trade_updates stream messages into a typed TradeUpdate covering at least: new/accepted, pending_new, partial_fill, fill, rejected, canceled, expired, replaced, pending_cancel, pending_replace, done_for_day, and stopped/suspended/calculated where documented. Include event, the full normalized order (Decimal filled_qty, filled_avg_price, hwm, stop_price, and so on), execution_id, price, qty, position_qty, and UTC timestamp. Partial fills must carry incremental and cumulative quantities correctly. Unknown events are preserved as typed unknowns.\n(2) Implement a stream session/state machine over an injectable websocket transport protocol, with no real network access in tests. It authenticates with environment-matched credentials, subscribes to trade_updates (listen), and handles auth failure as a typed error.\n(3) Reconnection uses bounded exponential backoff with jitter (injectable sleep) and a maximum attempt policy. Each reconnect emits an explicit Reconnected/Gap event so downstream reconciliation can query REST (open orders, orders by client_order_id, and activities since the last seen timestamp) to fill gaps. The session never assumes that no events were missed.\n(4) Updates are tagged with environment/account fingerprint. A message arriving on a session whose environment does not match is rejected.\n(5) This module only normalizes and emits. It never submits, cancels, or modifies orders.\n\nCreate tests/contracts/test_alpaca_trade_updates.py using JSON fixtures and fake transports, with no network access and no credentials. Positive and negative tests must cover: normalization of each listed event type; partial-fill then fill sequence quantities; Decimal fields; unknown event preservation; auth failure; that disconnect produces a Reconnected/Gap event followed by resubscription; that backoff is bounded by the injected sleep; activity pagination with a page cap; fill/fee/corporate activity normalization; idempotency-key stability and dedupe; and environment mismatch rejection.\n\nBefore editing, inspect: mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/http.py and auth.py (from e.1), account.py and assets.py (from e.2), any fill/activity/event domain types and the broker port from earlier phases, and existing async/clock abstractions. If orders.py from e.3 is present, reuse its order-normalization helper only when it exists. Otherwise implement a local normalizer and do not edit orders.py.",
.abracapocus/plans/ACTIVE/MIKE_TRADE_COMPLETE_PRODUCT/f/task_f.4_implement_fill_trade_update_and_cancel_event_ingestion_into_ledger.json:7:  "description": "Implement mike_trade/execution/fill_processor.py, a FillProcessor that ingests normalized broker trade updates and activities (from the e-phase normalization layer, or simulated SHADOW fills) and applies them to the order FSM and the account ledger exactly once at the application level.\n\n(1) Deduplication: every event carries a provider event/activity id, or a deterministic composite key when the provider has none. Persist the dedupe key in the same transaction as the ledger effect. A duplicate key is a no-op returning DUPLICATE. Fill processing must survive restart: re-ingesting the same activity after a restart changes nothing.\n(2) Fill application: for each new fill, compute the incremental filled quantity and price in Decimal, using the cumulative filled_qty when available so that missed or out-of-order partial updates are reconciled without double counting. Update the order's filled_qty and avg fill price, transition through PARTIALLY_FILLED/FILLED via the f.1 FSM, and update the position cycle's actual held quantity and cost basis. For entries, consume the corresponding f.2 cash reservation proportionally. On a terminal zero-fill or partial-then-cancel/expire, release the unused remainder.\n(3) Status-only events: ACCEPTED/PENDING/NEW never change quantity. A cancel or expire event moves CANCEL_PENDING (or a working state) to CANCELED/EXPIRED and releases reservations for any unfilled quantity. A rejected event releases the full reservation. A fill arriving after a cancel request but before cancel confirmation is applied normally.\n(4) Out-of-order events: an older status arriving after a newer one is recorded but not applied, per the f.1 FSM. Fills are always applied by cumulative quantity, never by event order. Fills for an unknown client_order_id are recorded as an UNMANAGED/reconciliation-drift event that blocks new entries, and are never silently dropped.\n(5) Oversell safety: if a sell fill (for example a broker protective stop racing an application EXIT_LONG) would reduce held quantity below zero, clamp nothing. Record a critical reconciliation-drift event, mark the position for reconciliation, and block new entries. Held long quantity is the confirmed sum of buys minus sells, and a position cycle closes only when the remaining quantity reaches exactly zero.\n(6) Emit protection-relevant notifications (for example positive-fill-confirmed with the current remaining qty) through an injected callback, for later protective-stop management. Do not implement stop placement here.\n\nCreate tests/unit/test_fill_processor.py covering:\n- single full fill;\n- multiple partial fills;\n- partial fill then cancel with reservation release;\n- rejected and canceled zero-fill orders;\n- a duplicate event id producing no double count;\n- re-ingestion after a simulated restart;\n- out-of-order cumulative fills;\n- an ACCEPTED event not changing quantity;\n- a fill after a cancel request;\n- a protective stop fill plus an exit fill exceeding held qty, producing drift and an entry block with no negative position silently created;\n- a fill for an unknown client_order_id producing drift;\n- Decimal-only cost basis.\n\nBefore editing, inspect: mike_trade/execution/order_fsm.py, mike_trade/execution/intents.py, mike_trade/execution/coordinator.py, mike_trade/brokers/ports.py, mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/updates.py, mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/activities.py, mike_trade/domain/trading.py, mike_trade/domain/protection.py, mike_trade/persistence/journal.py, mike_trade/persistence/repositories.py, mike_trade/persistence/transaction.py, and mike_trade/persistence/projections.py. Bounded decision budget: use existing persistence transaction/journal APIs, and do not alter schema or other modules.",

.abracapocus/plans/ACTIVE/MIKE_TRADE_COMPLETE_PRODUCT/PLAN_SKELETON.json:210:      "goal": "Build the replaceable Alpaca equity Broker adapter against the individual Alpaca Trading API, not the enterprise Broker API. Support stock BUY/SELL market/limit orders and protective stop operations only where documented and capability-validated. .abracapocus/plans/ACTIVE/MIKE_TRADE_COMPLETE_PRODUCT/e/task_e.3_implement_stock_order_placement_cancellation_lookup_and_client_order_ids.json:7:  "description": "Implement Alpaca stock order operations in mike_trade/brokers/alpaca/orders.py, using the e.1 AlpacaHttpClient and exceptions and the e.2 asset metadata and precision helpers.\n\n(1) Stable client_order_id: derive deterministically from mode/account fingerprint + position cycle id + purpose (for example entry, exit, protective_stop, trailing_stop, manual_close) + attempt number. Encode within Alpaca's client_order_id length limit (48 characters) using a compact, collision-resistant scheme, for example a short prefix plus a truncated hash. Expose a parse/inspect helper for audit. The ID must be generated and handed to an injected persistence callback or port (persist-before-send hook) before any HTTP submission. If persistence fails, submission is aborted.\n(2) Submission supports stock BUY/SELL market and limit orders with an explicit quantity-vs-notional choice made before submission; the two are mutually exclusive. Validate qty/notional/limit_price precision via the assets helpers. Fractional or notional orders are allowed only for fractionable assets and only with documented TIF (DAY). Enforce the known restriction that notional orders cannot be replaced.\n(3) Protective orders, exposed only through explicit methods: a standalone stop sell (stop_price) and a standalone native trailing_stop sell using exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent. Trailing stops are never OTO, bracket, or OCO legs. The methods accept a capability-check callable and refuse (fail closed, typed error) when the capability is not marked proven. Reject sell quantities greater than the caller-supplied known position quantity, so overlapping sells cannot create a short.\n(4) Unknown outcome: on timeout, transport loss, or AlpacaUnknownOutcome during submission, query GET /v2/orders:by_client_order_id with the same ID before anything else. If the order is found, return it. If 404 is confirmed, return a typed NotSubmitted result that permits retry only with the same ID. If the lookup itself fails, raise OrderOutcomeUnresolved and never mint a new attempt ID. A new attempt number is allowed only after the original status is resolved terminal or not-submitted.\n(5) Lookup by broker order id (GET /v2/orders/{id}), lookup by client_order_id, list open orders (status=open, bounded limit, nested where useful), and cancel by id (DELETE /v2/orders/{id}). A 404 or 422 on cancel of an already terminal order is mapped to a typed result. Replace (PATCH) is allowed only for limit price, stop price, or trail fields when the capability allows it. Never assume OTO replacement.\n(6) Normalize orders into Decimal fields: qty, notional, filled_qty, filled_avg_price, limit_price, stop_price, trail_price, trail_percent, and hwm. def commit_then_effect(
    journal: DomainEventJournal,
    events: Iterable[NewEvent],
    effect: Callable[[tuple[RecordedEvent, ...]], Any],
) -> AppendResult:
    """Commit intent events, then invoke ``effect`` exactly once.

    The effect is never called if persistence fails.  If the effect itself
    raises, the recorded intent deliberately remains durable; the caller must
    reconcile that durable intent with the external system before retrying.
    """
    result = journal.append(events)
    effect(result.recorded_events)
    return result
"""Broker-neutral account, capability, health, and operator-control snapshots.

Validation decisions: timestamps must have a zero UTC offset; account monetary
values are finite :class:`~decimal.Decimal` instances; and unsafe account flags
are the explicit broker restrictions that directly block trading.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Mapping


def _require_utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> None:
    """Require an aware datetime whose UTC offset is zero."""
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a UTC-aware datetime")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC (zero offset)")


def _require_decimal(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
    if value is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")


def _require_nonempty(value: str, name: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")


class AccountEnvironment(Enum):
    BACKTEST = "BACKTEST"
    SHADOW = "SHADOW"
    PAPER = "PAPER"
    LIVE = "LIVE"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AccountScope:
    """Identity boundary for account-wide cash, buying power, and positions."""

    environment: AccountEnvironment
    account_id: str
    scenario: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.environment, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AccountEnvironment")
        _require_nonempty(self.account_id, "account_id")
        if self.environment in (AccountEnvironment.SHADOW, AccountEnvironment.BACKTEST):
            _require_nonempty(self.scenario, "scenario")
        elif self.scenario is not None:
            raise ValueError("scenario is only valid for SHADOW and BACKTEST scopes")

    @property
    def scope_id(self) -> str:
        """Stable, environment-qualified scope key."""
        prefix = self.environment.value.lower()
        if self.scenario is None:
            return f"{prefix}:{self.account_id}"
        return f"{prefix}:{self.account_id}:{self.scenario}"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AccountSnapshot:
    """Immutable account-level financial state; values never belong to a symbol."""

    scope: AccountScope
    as_of: datetime
    cash: Decimal
    equity: Decimal
    buying_power: Decimal
    daytrading_buying_power: Decimal | None = None
    portfolio_value: Decimal | None = None
    pattern_day_trader: bool = False
    trading_blocked: bool = False
    account_blocked: bool = False
    trade_suspended_by_user: bool = False
    shorting_enabled: bool = False
    source: str = ""
    currency: str = "USD"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.scope, AccountScope):
            raise TypeError("scope must be an AccountScope")
        _require_utc(self.as_of, "as_of")
        for name in ("cash", "equity", "buying_power", "daytrading_buying_power", "portfolio_value"):
            _require_decimal(getattr(self, name), name)
        if self.currency != "USD":
            raise ValueError("currency must be USD")
        if not isinstance(self.source, str) or not self.source.strip():
            raise ValueError("source must be a non-empty provenance string")

    @property
    def unsafe_flags(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Names of broker restrictions that block new entries."""
        return tuple(
            name
            for name in ("trading_blocked", "account_blocked", "trade_suspended_by_user")
            if getattr(self, name)
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BrokerCapabilities:
    provider: str
    environment: AccountEnvironment
    supported_order_types: frozenset[str]
    supports_fractional: bool
    supports_notional: bool
    supports_native_trailing_stop: bool
    supports_extended_hours: bool
    supports_short: bool = False
    paper_verified_combinations: frozenset[tuple[str, bool]] = field(default_factory=frozenset)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        _require_nonempty(self.provider, "provider")
        if not isinstance(self.environment, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AccountEnvironment")
        if not isinstance(self.supported_order_types, frozenset):
            raise TypeError("supported_order_types must be a frozenset")
        if not isinstance(self.paper_verified_combinations, frozenset):
            raise TypeError("paper_verified_combinations must be a frozenset")

    def supports_order(self, order_type: str, fractional: bool) -> bool:
        """Return true only for an explicitly advertised, verified combination."""
        if order_type not in self.supported_order_types:
            return False
        if fractional:
            if not self.supports_fractional:
                return False
            if (order_type, True) not in self.paper_verified_combinations:
                return False
        return True


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MarketDataCapabilities:
    provider: str
    feed: str
    is_consolidated: bool
    supports_streaming: bool
    supported_timeframes: frozenset[str]
    max_streaming_symbols: int | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        _require_nonempty(self.provider, "provider")
        _require_nonempty(self.feed, "feed")
        if not isinstance(self.supported_timeframes, frozenset):
            raise TypeError("supported_timeframes must be a frozenset")
        if self.max_streaming_symbols is not None and self.max_streaming_symbols < 0:
            raise ValueError("max_streaming_symbols must be non-negative")

    """Safe offline defaults. Concrete adapter imports must be lazy inside factories."""
    return {

        "broker": NullBroker,
        "market_data": NullMarketData,
        "research": lambda: None,

_FACTORIES_BY_MODE: Mapping[ExecutionMode, Callable[[], dict[str, Callable[[], object]]]] = {
    ExecutionMode.BACKTEST: _placeholder_factories,
    ExecutionMode.SHADOW: _placeholder_factories,
    ExecutionMode.PAPER: _placeholder_factories,
}


def build_runtime(
    settings: AppSettings, *, overrides: Mapping[str, object] | None = None
) -> Runtime:
    """Builds the dependency-injected Runtime object graph.

    Component factories are selected by ``settings.mode``; entries in ``overrides`` take
    precedence so tests can supply fakes. Building a LIVE runtime fails closed.
    """
    supplied = dict(overrides or {})
    unknown = sorted(set(supplied) - OVERRIDABLE_SLOTS)
    if unknown:
        raise ConfigurationError(
            f"Unknown runtime override(s): {', '.join(unknown)}",
            code="UNKNOWN_OVERRIDE",
            context={"unknown": unknown},
        )

**Replacement and race safety:** Updating a stepped stop requires capability-checked broker replacement, **not** cancel/recreate by default. Alpaca's PATCH semantics are asynchronous; a successful response is not proof that the old order has been replaced. Persist intent, await trade update or fetch authoritative order state, then confirm the new stop before treating it as effective. If replacement is rejected/unknown, preserve the last verified broker protection if it still exists, suspend additional entry activity, surface `TRAIL_UPDATE_UNCONFIRMED`, and reconcile; never submit an overlapping full-position stop or discretionary SELL. Respect update rate limits, broker tick/quantity precision, replacement cooldown, market hours and restrictions on fractional/notional orders. Native stop trails cannot be converted from dollar to percent by PATCH. [A13][A14]

**Lifecycle and recovery:** Persist entry reference, high-water mark, step anchor, monotone desired and confirmed stop levels, broker order IDs/status and policy/version for every update. On restart, recover from broker orders and fills **before** resuming ratchets; reconcile broker native `hwm` and `stop_price` as authoritative, or reconstruct stepped state from durable events without guessing missing market highs. A stopped/offline app leaves its **last confirmed stepped** broker stop in force if still valid, but it cannot continue step updates until online; mark `TRAIL_STALE/OFFLINE` on dashboard. GTC versus DAY expiry and overnight gaps remain explicit risks. On strategy/manual full SELL, coordinate stop cancellation/fill and verify the position is flat with no orphan sell order; native trailing fill is itself an exit and bypasses minimum hold.

**Data/reporting/controls:** Dashboard and CLI show mode, distance, step, entry reference, observed/broker high watermark, anchor, desired/confirmed stop, protected shares, last update time, broker order ID, `ACTIVE/UPDATING/UNCONFIRMED/TRIGGERED/EXPIRED/OFFLINE` state, and warning if data feed/protection diverges. +    order_class: str | None
+    qty: Decimal | None
+    notional: Decimal | None
+    filled_qty: Decimal | None
+    filled_avg_price: Decimal | None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None
+    hwm: Decimal | None
+    legs: tuple["AlpacaOrder", ...]
+    created_at: datetime | None
+    updated_at: datetime | None
+    submitted_at: datetime | None
+    filled_at: datetime | None
+    expired_at: datetime | None
+    canceled_at: datetime | None
+    failed_at: datetime | None
+    replaced_at: datetime | None
+
+    @property
+    def id(self) -> str:
+        return self.order_id
+
+    @property
+    def source_environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self.environment
+
+    @property
+    def is_terminal(self) -> bool:
+        return self.status.lower() in _TERMINAL_STATUSES
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class NotSubmitted:
+    """Confirmed absence after an unknown POST outcome.
+
+    Retrying the same logical attempt must reuse ``client_order_id``.
+    """
+
+    client_order_id: str
+    retry_with_same_client_order_id: bool = True
+    submitted: bool = False
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CancelResult:
+    """Typed cancellation result, including idempotent terminal outcomes."""
+
+    order_id: str
+    cancel_requested: bool
+    already_terminal: bool
+    status: str | None = None
+
+
+def _parse_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp or null")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _normalize_order(
+    data: Mapping[str, Any], *, environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+) -> AlpacaOrder:
+    raw_legs = data.get("legs")
+    if raw_legs is None:
+        legs: tuple[AlpacaOrder, ...] = ()
+    elif isinstance(raw_legs, list):
+        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in raw_legs):
+            raise ValueError("order legs must be JSON objects")
+        legs = tuple(_normalize_order(item, environment=environment) for item in raw_legs)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("order legs must be a JSON array or null")
+
+    def optional_decimal(name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        return _decimal(data.get(name), field=name, optional=True)
+
+    order_class = data.get("order_class")
+    if order_class is not None and not isinstance(order_class, str):
+        raise ValueError("order_class must be a string or null")
+    return AlpacaOrder(
+        environment=environment,
+        order_id=_require_text(data.get("id"), field="id"),
+        client_order_id=_require_text(data.get("client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"),
+        symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),
+        status=_require_text(data.get("status"), field="status").lower(),
+        side=_require_text(data.get("side"), field="side").lower(),
+        type=_require_text(data.get("type", data.get("order_type")), field="type").lower(),
+        time_in_force=_require_text(data.get("time_in_force"), field="time_in_force").lower(),
+        order_class=None if order_class is None else order_class.lower(),
+        qty=optional_decimal("qty"),
+        notional=optional_decimal("notional"),
+        filled_qty=optional_decimal("filled_qty"),
+        filled_avg_price=optional_decimal("filled_avg_price"),
+        limit_price=optional_decimal("limit_price"),
+        stop_price=optional_decimal("stop_price"),
+        trail_price=optional_decimal("trail_price"),
+        trail_percent=optional_decimal("trail_percent"),
+        hwm=optional_decimal("hwm"),
+        legs=legs,
+        created_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("created_at"), field="created_at"),
+        updated_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("updated_at"), field="updated_at"),
+        submitted_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("submitted_at"), field="submitted_at"),
+        filled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("filled_at"), field="filled_at"),
+        expired_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("expired_at"), field="expired_at"),
+        canceled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("canceled_at"), field="canceled_at"),
+        failed_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("failed_at"), field="failed_at"),
+        replaced_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("replaced_at"), field="replaced_at"),
+    )
+
+
+def _enum_string(value: str | Enum, *, field: str, allowed: frozenset[str]) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string or enum")
+    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
+    if normalized not in allowed:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported {field}: {raw!r}")
+    return normalized
+
+
+class AlpacaOrderService:
+    """Synchronous order boundary over an injected Alpaca HTTP client."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: Any,
+        *,
+        persist_before_send: Callable[..., Any] | Any | None = None,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        for method in ("get", "post", "patch", "delete"):
+            if not callable(getattr(client, method, None)):
+                raise TypeError(f"client must expose {method}()")
+        resolved_environment = environment if environment is not None else getattr(client, "environment", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        if persist_before_send is not None:
+            candidate = getattr(persist_before_send, "persist_before_send", persist_before_send)
+            if not callable(candidate):
+                raise TypeError("persist_before_send must be callable or expose persist_before_send()")
+        self._client = client
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
+        self._persist_hook = persist_before_send
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def submit_order(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        side: str | Enum,
+        order_type: str | Enum,
+        sizing: OrderSizing | None = None,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a stock BUY/SELL market or limit order exactly once."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        if sizing is not None and (qty is not None or notional is not None):
+            raise ValueError("pass sizing or qty/notional, not both")
+        resolved_sizing = sizing if sizing is not None else OrderSizing(qty=qty, notional=notional)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_sizing, OrderSizing):
+            raise TypeError("sizing must be an OrderSizing")
+        resolved_side = _enum_string(side, field="side", allowed=frozenset({"buy", "sell"}))
+        resolved_type = _enum_string(
+            order_type, field="order_type", allowed=frozenset({"market", "limit"})
+        )
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        validated = self._validate_sizing(resolved_sizing, asset, tif=tif)
+        if resolved_type == "limit":
+            if limit_price is None:
+                raise ValueError("limit orders require limit_price")
+            price = quantize_price(limit_price, asset, strict=True)
+        else:
+            if limit_price is not None:
+                raise ValueError("market orders must not specify limit_price")
+            price = None
+        self._check_oversell(validated.qty, resolved_side, known_position_qty)
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "side": resolved_side,
+            "type": resolved_type,
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+        }
+        if validated.qty is not None:
+            body["qty"] = str(validated.qty)
+        else:
+            body["notional"] = str(validated.notional)
+        if price is not None:
+            body["limit_price"] = str(price)
+        return self._submit(body, cycle_id=cycle_id, purpose=purpose, attempt=attempt)
+
+    def submit_stop_sell(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        stop_price: Decimal | int | str,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a capability-proven standalone protective stop SELL."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
+        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
+        capability = f"standalone_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
+        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
+        assert sizing.qty is not None
+        self._check_oversell(sizing.qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
+        price = quantize_price(stop_price, asset, strict=True)
+        body = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "qty": str(sizing.qty),
+            "side": "sell",
+            "type": "stop",
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+            "stop_price": str(price),
+        }
+        return self._submit(
+            body,
+            cycle_id=cycle_id,
+            purpose=OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
+            attempt=attempt,
+        )
+
+    def submit_trailing_stop_sell(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
+        trail_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        trail_percent: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a standalone native trailing-stop SELL (never a linked leg)."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
+            raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
+        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
+        capability = f"standalone_trailing_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
+        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
+        assert sizing.qty is not None
+        self._check_oversell(sizing.qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "qty": str(sizing.qty),
+            "side": "sell",
+            "type": "trailing_stop",
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+        }
+        if trail_price is not None:
+            body["trail_price"] = str(quantize_price(trail_price, asset, strict=True))
+        else:
+            body["trail_percent"] = str(
+                _positive_decimal(trail_percent, field="trail_percent")
+            )
+        return self._submit(
+            body,
+            cycle_id=cycle_id,
+            purpose=OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
+            attempt=attempt,
+        )
+
+    def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
+        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
+            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
+                return None
+            raise
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders/{id}")
+
+    def get_order_by_client_order_id(self, client_order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(
+                "/v2/orders:by_client_order_id",
+                params={"client_order_id": cleaned},
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
+            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
+                return None
+            raise
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders:by_client_order_id")
+
+    def list_open_orders(self, *, limit: int = 100, nested: bool = True) -> list[AlpacaOrder]:
+        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 500:
+            raise ValueError("limit must be an int between 1 and 500")
+        if not isinstance(nested, bool):
+            raise ValueError("nested must be bool")
+        data = self._client.get(
+            "/v2/orders",
+            params={"status": "open", "limit": limit, "nested": nested},
+        )
+        if not isinstance(data, list):
+            raise ValueError("GET /v2/orders must return a JSON array")
+        return [
+            self._normalize_response(item, endpoint="GET /v2/orders") for item in data
+        ]
+
+    def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> CancelResult:
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+        try:
+            self._client.delete(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
+        except Exception as exc:  # 404/422 are idempotent terminal outcomes
+            if self._status_code(exc) in {404, 422}:
+                return CancelResult(
+                    order_id=cleaned,
+                    cancel_requested=False,
+                    already_terminal=True,
+                    status="already_terminal",
+                )
+            raise
+        return CancelResult(
+            order_id=cleaned,
+            cancel_requested=True,
+            already_terminal=False,
+            status="cancel_requested",
+        )
+
+    def replace_order(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
+        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        stop_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        trail_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        trail_percent: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        order: AlpacaOrder | None = None,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder:
+        """Replace only supported price/trail fields after a proven capability."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        current = order if order is not None else self.get_order(cleaned)
+        if current is None:
+            raise AlpacaNotFound("order not found", status_code=404)
+        if current.order_id != cleaned:
+            raise ValueError("supplied order does not match order_id")
+        if current.notional is not None:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                "replace_notional_order",
+                "Alpaca notional orders cannot be replaced",
+            )
+        changes = {
+            "limit_price": limit_price,
+            "stop_price": stop_price,
+            "trail_price": trail_price,
+            "trail_percent": trail_percent,
+        }
+        supplied = [name for name, value in changes.items() if value is not None]
+        if not supplied:
+            raise ValueError("a replacement price or trail field is required")
+        trail_fields = {name for name in supplied if name.startswith("trail_")}
+        if len(trail_fields) > 1 or (trail_fields and len(supplied) > 1):
+            raise ValueError("replace exactly one trail field, without price fields")
+        capability = "replace_" + (next(iter(trail_fields)) if trail_fields else "_and_".join(supplied))
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
+        body: dict[str, str] = {}
+        for field in ("limit_price", "stop_price", "trail_price"):
+            value = changes[field]
+            if value is not None:
+                body[field] = str(quantize_price(value, asset, strict=True))
+        if trail_percent is not None:
+            body["trail_percent"] = str(
+                _positive_decimal(trail_percent, field="trail_percent")
+            )
+        data = self._client.patch(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", json_body=body, params=None)
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="PATCH /v2/orders/{id}")
+
+    def _submit(
+        self,
+        body: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        cycle_id: str,
+        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+        attempt: int,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        client_order_id = make_client_order_id(
+            self._environment, self._fingerprint, cycle_id, purpose, attempt
+        )
+        request = dict(body)
+        request["client_order_id"] = client_order_id
+        self._persist_before_send(client_order_id, request)
+        try:
+            data = self._client.post("/v2/orders", json_body=request, params=None)
+        except _UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_ERRORS as submit_error:
+            try:
+                found = self.get_order_by_client_order_id(client_order_id)
+            except BaseException as lookup_error:
+                unresolved = OrderOutcomeUnresolved(client_order_id, lookup_error)
+                unresolved.add_note(f"submission error: {submit_error!r}")
+                raise unresolved from lookup_error
+            if found is None:
+                return NotSubmitted(client_order_id=client_order_id)
+            return found
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="POST /v2/orders")
+
+    def _persist_before_send(self, client_order_id: str, request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+        if self._persist_hook is None:
+            raise TypeError("a persist_before_send hook is required for submission")
+        hook = getattr(self._persist_hook, "persist_before_send", self._persist_hook)
+        frozen_request = MappingProxyType(dict(request))
+        try:
+            signature = inspect.signature(hook)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            hook(client_order_id, frozen_request)
+            return
+        try:
+            signature.bind(client_order_id, frozen_request)
+        except TypeError:
+            try:
+                signature.bind(client_order_id)
+            except TypeError as exc:
+                raise TypeError(
+                    "persist_before_send must accept client_order_id and optionally request"
+                ) from exc
+            hook(client_order_id)
+        else:
+            hook(client_order_id, frozen_request)
+
+    def _validate_asset(self, asset: AlpacaAsset) -> AlpacaAsset:
+        if not isinstance(asset, AlpacaAsset):
+            raise TypeError("asset must be an AlpacaAsset")
+        if asset.environment is not self._environment:
+            raise ValueError("asset environment does not match the order service")
+        if asset.fingerprint != self._fingerprint:
+            raise ValueError("asset fingerprint does not match the order service")
+        if not asset.eligibility().eligible:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable("tradable_active_us_equity", "asset is not eligible")
+        return asset
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_sizing(
+        sizing: OrderSizing, asset: AlpacaAsset, *, tif: str
+    ) -> OrderSizing:
+        if sizing.qty is not None:
+            qty = quantize_quantity(sizing.qty, asset, strict=True)
+            fractional = qty != qty.to_integral_value()
+            if fractional and not asset.fractionable:
+                raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                    "fractional_order", "fractional orders require a fractionable asset"
+                )
+            if fractional and tif != "day":
+                raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                    "fractional_order_tif", "fractional orders require DAY time_in_force"
+                )
+            return OrderSizing(qty=qty)
+        assert sizing.notional is not None
+        if not asset.fractionable:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                "notional_order", "notional orders require a fractionable asset"
+            )
+        if tif != "day":
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                "notional_order_tif", "notional orders require DAY time_in_force"
+            )
+        notional = quantize_price(sizing.notional, asset, strict=True)
+        return OrderSizing(notional=notional)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _check_oversell(
+        qty: Decimal | None,
+        side: str,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if side != "sell" or qty is None or known_position_qty is None:
+            return
+        known = _positive_decimal(known_position_qty, field="known_position_qty")
+        if qty > known:
+            raise OversellRejected(qty, known)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require_capability(
+        checker: Callable[[str], bool] | None, capability: str
+    ) -> None:
+        if checker is None:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(capability)
+        try:
+            proven = checker(capability)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(
+                capability, f"capability check failed closed for {capability!r}"
+            ) from exc
+        if proven is not True:
+            raise CapabilityUnavailable(capability)
+
+    def _require_live_authorization(self) -> None:
+        if self._environment is not AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE:
+            return
+        marker = getattr(self._client, "live_authorized", None)
+        if marker is None:
+            marker = getattr(self._client, "_live_authorized", None)
+        # AlpacaHttpClient's constructor itself refuses an unauthorized LIVE
+        # instance.  Test doubles must carry an explicit marker.
+        if marker is None and isinstance(self._client, AlpacaHttpClient):
+            marker = True
+        if marker is not True:
+            raise LiveAuthorizationRequired(
+                "LIVE submit, replace, and cancel require explicit live authorization"
+            )
+
+    def _normalize_response(self, data: Any, *, endpoint: str) -> AlpacaOrder:
+        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"{endpoint} must return a JSON object")
+        return _normalize_order(data, environment=self._environment)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _status_code(exc: BaseException) -> int | None:
+        status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
+        if isinstance(status, int):
+            return status
+        if isinstance(exc, AlpacaNotFound):
+            return 404
+        if isinstance(exc, AlpacaUnprocessable):
+            return 422
+        return None

+"""Alpaca equity order submission, lookup, replacement, and cancellation.
+
+Mutation requests are deliberately single-shot.  A submission intent is handed
+to the injected persistence hook before POST, and an unknown POST outcome is
+resolved by ``client_order_id`` lookup without issuing a second POST.

+_CLIENT_ORDER_ID_RE = re.compile(
+    r"^mt1-(?P<purpose>[a-z]{1,3})-(?P<attempt>[0-9a-z]+)-(?P<digest>[0-9a-f]{32})$"
+)
+_TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(
+    {"filled", "canceled", "cancelled", "expired", "rejected", "replaced", "done_for_day"}
+)
+_UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_ERRORS = (
+    AlpacaUnknownOutcome,
+    AlpacaTimeout,
+    AlpacaTransportError,
+    httpx.TimeoutException,
+    httpx.TransportError,
+    TimeoutError,
+    ConnectionError,
+)

+class OrderPurpose(Enum):
+    """Stable lineage purposes encoded in an Alpaca ``client_order_id``."""
+
+    ENTRY = "entry"
+    EXIT = "exit"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+
+
+_PURPOSE_CODES = {
+    OrderPurpose.ENTRY: "en",
+    OrderPurpose.EXIT: "ex",
+    OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP: "ps",
+    OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP: "ts",
+    OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE: "mc",
+}
+_CODE_PURPOSES = {code: purpose for purpose, code in _PURPOSE_CODES.items()}

+def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _positive_decimal(value: Any, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    result = _decimal(value, field=field)
+    assert result is not None
+    if result <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be > 0")
+    return result
+
+
+def _base36(value: int) -> str:
+    alphabet = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
+    if value == 0:
+        return "0"
+    encoded = ""
+    while value:
+        value, remainder = divmod(value, 36)
+        encoded = alphabet[remainder] + encoded
+    return encoded
+
+
+def _purpose(value: OrderPurpose | str | Enum) -> OrderPurpose:
+    if isinstance(value, OrderPurpose):
+        return value
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise ValueError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose or string")
+    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
+    aliases = {"strategy_exit": "exit"}
+    normalized = aliases.get(normalized, normalized)
+    try:
+        return OrderPurpose(normalized)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported order purpose: {raw!r}") from None
+

+def make_client_order_id(
+    mode: AlpacaEnvironment | str | Enum,
+    account_fingerprint: str,
+    cycle_id: str,
+    purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+    attempt: int,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a deterministic, audit-inspectable ID no longer than 48 chars.
+
+    The 128-bit truncated SHA-256 digest covers length-prefixed canonical input,
+    while purpose and base-36 attempt remain directly inspectable.
+    """
+
+    raw_mode = getattr(mode, "value", mode)
+    if not isinstance(raw_mode, str) or not raw_mode.strip():
+        raise ValueError("mode must be a non-empty string or enum")
+    fingerprint = _require_text(account_fingerprint, field="account_fingerprint")
+    cycle = _require_text(cycle_id, field="cycle_id")
+    resolved_purpose = _purpose(purpose)
+    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 0:
+        raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 0")
+    components = (
+        raw_mode.strip().upper(),
+        fingerprint,
+        cycle,
+        resolved_purpose.value,
+        str(attempt),
+    )
+    canonical = "".join(f"{len(item)}:{item}" for item in components)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
+    result = f"mt1-{_PURPOSE_CODES[resolved_purpose]}-{_base36(attempt)}-{digest}"
+    if len(result) > 48:  # defensive: current format is at most 47 for bounded ints
+        raise ValueError("attempt is too large for Alpaca's client_order_id limit")
+    return result
+
+
+def parse_client_order_id(client_order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Inspect an ID generated by :func:`make_client_order_id`.
+
+    Hashed identity inputs cannot be reversed; the result exposes the format
+    version, purpose, attempt, and digest for audit and comparison.
+    """
+
+    value = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+    match = _CLIENT_ORDER_ID_RE.fullmatch(value)
+    if match is None or match.group("purpose") not in _CODE_PURPOSES:
+        raise ValueError("not a mike_trade Alpaca client_order_id")
+    return {
+        "version": 1,
+        "purpose": _CODE_PURPOSES[match.group("purpose")],
+        "attempt": int(match.group("attempt"), 36),
+        "digest": match.group("digest"),
+        "client_order_id": value,
+    }
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderSizing:
+    """Explicit and mutually exclusive quantity-versus-notional selection."""
+
+    qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None
+    notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None

+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

+def _parse_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp or null")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+

+def _normalize_order(
+    data: Mapping[str, Any], *, environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+) -> AlpacaOrder:
+    raw_legs = data.get("legs")

+        legs: tuple[AlpacaOrder, ...] = ()
+    elif isinstance(raw_legs, list):
+        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in raw_legs):
+            raise ValueError("order legs must be JSON objects")
+        legs = tuple(_normalize_order(item, environment=environment) for item in raw_legs)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("order legs must be a JSON array or null")
+
+    def optional_decimal(name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        return _decimal(data.get(name), field=name, optional=True)
+
+    order_class = data.get("order_class")
+    if order_class is not None and not isinstance(order_class, str):
+        raise ValueError("order_class must be a string or null")
+    return AlpacaOrder(
+        environment=environment,
+        order_id=_require_text(data.get("id"), field="id"),
+        client_order_id=_require_text(data.get("client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"),
+        symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),

+        time_in_force=_require_text(data.get("time_in_force"), field="time_in_force").lower(),
+        order_class=None if order_class is None else order_class.lower(),

+        notional=optional_decimal("notional"),
+        filled_qty=optional_decimal("filled_qty"),
+        filled_avg_price=optional_decimal("filled_avg_price"),
+        limit_price=optional_decimal("limit_price"),
+        stop_price=optional_decimal("stop_price"),
+        trail_price=optional_decimal("trail_price"),
+        trail_percent=optional_decimal("trail_percent"),
+        hwm=optional_decimal("hwm"),
+        legs=legs,
+        created_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("created_at"), field="created_at"),
+        updated_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("updated_at"), field="updated_at"),
+        submitted_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("submitted_at"), field="submitted_at"),
+        filled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("filled_at"), field="filled_at"),
+        expired_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("expired_at"), field="expired_at"),
+        canceled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("canceled_at"), field="canceled_at"),

+def _enum_string(value: str | Enum, *, field: str, allowed: frozenset[str]) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string or enum")
+    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
+    if normalized not in allowed:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported {field}: {raw!r}")
+    return normalized

+class AlpacaOrderService:
+    """Synchronous order boundary over an injected Alpaca HTTP client."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: Any,
+        *,
+        persist_before_send: Callable[..., Any] | Any | None = None,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        for method in ("get", "post", "patch", "delete"):
+            if not callable(getattr(client, method, None)):
+                raise TypeError(f"client must expose {method}()")
+        resolved_environment = environment if environment is not None else getattr(client, "environment", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        if persist_before_send is not None:
+            candidate = getattr(persist_before_send, "persist_before_send", persist_before_send)
+            if not callable(candidate):
+                raise TypeError("persist_before_send must be callable or expose persist_before_send()")
+        self._client = client
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
+        self._persist_hook = persist_before_send
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def submit_order(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        side: str | Enum,
+        order_type: str | Enum,
+        sizing: OrderSizing | None = None,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a stock BUY/SELL market or limit order exactly once."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        if sizing is not None and (qty is not None or notional is not None):
+            raise ValueError("pass sizing or qty/notional, not both")
+        resolved_sizing = sizing if sizing is not None else OrderSizing(qty=qty, notional=notional)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_sizing, OrderSizing):
+            raise TypeError("sizing must be an OrderSizing")
+        resolved_side = _enum_string(side, field="side", allowed=frozenset({"buy", "sell"}))
+        resolved_type = _enum_string(
+            order_type, field="order_type", allowed=frozenset({"market", "limit"})
+        )
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        validated = self._validate_sizing(resolved_sizing, asset, tif=tif)
+        if resolved_type == "limit":
+            if limit_price is None:
+                raise ValueError("limit orders require limit_price")
+            price = quantize_price(limit_price, asset, strict=True)
+        else:
+            if limit_price is not None:
+                raise ValueError("market orders must not specify limit_price")
+            price = None
+        self._check_oversell(validated.qty, resolved_side, known_position_qty)
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "side": resolved_side,
+            "type": resolved_type,
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+        }
+        if validated.qty is not None:
+            body["qty"] = str(validated.qty)
+        else:
+            body["notional"] = str(validated.notional)
+        if price is not None:
+            body["limit_price"] = str(price)
+        return self._submit(body, cycle_id=cycle_id, purpose=purpose, attempt=attempt)
+
+    def submit_stop_sell(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        stop_price: Decimal | int | str,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a capability-proven standalone protective stop SELL."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
+        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
+        capability = f"standalone_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
+        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
+        assert sizing.qty is not None
+        self._check_oversell(sizing.qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
+        price = quantize_price(stop_price, asset, strict=True)
+        body = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "qty": str(sizing.qty),
+            "side": "sell",
+            "type": "stop",
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+            "stop_price": str(price),
+        }
+        return self._submit(
+            body,
+            cycle_id=cycle_id,
+            purpose=OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
+            attempt=attempt,
+        )
+
+    def submit_trailing_stop_sell(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
+        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
+        trail_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        trail_percent: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a standalone native trailing-stop SELL (never a linked leg)."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
+            raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
+        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
+        capability = f"standalone_trailing_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
+        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
+        assert sizing.qty is not None
+        self._check_oversell(sizing.qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "qty": str(sizing.qty),
+            "side": "sell",
+            "type": "trailing_stop",
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+        }
+        if trail_price is not None:
+            body["trail_price"] = str(quantize_price(trail_price, asset, strict=True))
+        else:
+            body["trail_percent"] = str(
+                _positive_decimal(trail_percent, field="trail_percent")
+            )
+        return self._submit(
+            body,
+            cycle_id=cycle_id,
+            purpose=OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
+            attempt=attempt,
+        )
+
+    def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
+        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
+            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
+                return None
+            raise
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders/{id}")
+
+    def get_order_by_client_order_id(self, client_order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(
+                "/v2/orders:by_client_order_id",
+                params={"client_order_id": cleaned},

    """Return a deterministic, audit-inspectable ID no longer than 48 chars.

    The 128-bit truncated SHA-256 digest covers length-prefixed canonical input,
    while purpose and base-36 attempt remain directly inspectable.
    """

    raw_mode = getattr(mode, "value", mode)
    if not isinstance(raw_mode, str) or not raw_mode.strip():
        raise ValueError("mode must be a non-empty string or enum")
    fingerprint = _require_text(account_fingerprint, field="account_fingerprint")
    cycle = _require_text(cycle_id, field="cycle_id")

        raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 0")

        raw_mode.strip().upper(),
        fingerprint,
        cycle,
        resolved_purpose.value,
        str(attempt),
    )

    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
    result = f"mt1-{_PURPOSE_CODES[resolved_purpose]}-{_base36(attempt)}-{digest}"
    if len(result) > 48:  # defensive: current format is at most 47 for bounded ints
        raise ValueError("attempt is too large for Alpaca's client_order_id limit")
    return result

+    try:
+        return OrderPurpose(normalized)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported order purpose: {raw!r}") from None
+
+
+def make_client_order_id(
+    mode: AlpacaEnvironment | str | Enum,
+    account_fingerprint: str,
+    cycle_id: str,
+    purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+    attempt: int,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a deterministic, audit-inspectable ID no longer than 48 chars.
+
+    The 128-bit truncated SHA-256 digest covers length-prefixed canonical input,
+    while purpose and base-36 attempt remain directly inspectable.
+    """
+
+    raw_mode = getattr(mode, "value", mode)
+    if not isinstance(raw_mode, str) or not raw_mode.strip():
+        raise ValueError("mode must be a non-empty string or enum")
+    fingerprint = _require_text(account_fingerprint, field="account_fingerprint")
+    cycle = _require_text(cycle_id, field="cycle_id")
+    resolved_purpose = _purpose(purpose)
+    if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 0:
+        raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 0")
+    components = (
+        raw_mode.strip().upper(),
+        fingerprint,
+        cycle,
+        resolved_purpose.value,
+        str(attempt),
+    )
+    canonical = "".join(f"{len(item)}:{item}" for item in components)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
+    result = f"mt1-{_PURPOSE_CODES[resolved_purpose]}-{_base36(attempt)}-{digest}"
+    if len(result) > 48:  # defensive: current format is at most 47 for bounded ints
+        raise ValueError("attempt is too large for Alpaca's client_order_id limit")
+    return result
+
+
+def parse_client_order_id(client_order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Inspect an ID generated by :func:`make_client_order_id`.
+
+    Hashed identity inputs cannot be reversed; the result exposes the format
+    version, purpose, attempt, and digest for audit and comparison.
+    """
+
+    value = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+    match = _CLIENT_ORDER_ID_RE.fullmatch(value)
+    if match is None or match.group("purpose") not in _CODE_PURPOSES:
+        raise ValueError("not a mike_trade Alpaca client_order_id")
+    return {
+        "version": 1,
+        "purpose": _CODE_PURPOSES[match.group("purpose")],
+        "attempt": int(match.group("attempt"), 36),
+        "digest": match.group("digest"),
+        "client_order_id": value,
+    }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderSizing:
+    """Explicit and mutually exclusive quantity-versus-notional selection."""

+    qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None

+def _parse_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware timestamp or null")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+

+def _normalize_order(
+    data: Mapping[str, Any], *, environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+) -> AlpacaOrder:
+    raw_legs = data.get("legs")
+    if raw_legs is None:
+        legs: tuple[AlpacaOrder, ...] = ()
+    elif isinstance(raw_legs, list):
+        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in raw_legs):
+            raise ValueError("order legs must be JSON objects")
+        legs = tuple(_normalize_order(item, environment=environment) for item in raw_legs)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("order legs must be a JSON array or null")
+
+    def optional_decimal(name: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        return _decimal(data.get(name), field=name, optional=True)
+
+    order_class = data.get("order_class")
+    if order_class is not None and not isinstance(order_class, str):
+        raise ValueError("order_class must be a string or null")
+    return AlpacaOrder(
+        environment=environment,
+        order_id=_require_text(data.get("id"), field="id"),
+        client_order_id=_require_text(data.get("client_order_id"), field="client_order_id"),
+        symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),
+        status=_require_text(data.get("status"), field="status").lower(),
+        side=_require_text(data.get("side"), field="side").lower(),
+        type=_require_text(data.get("type", data.get("order_type")), field="type").lower(),
+        time_in_force=_require_text(data.get("time_in_force"), field="time_in_force").lower(),
+        order_class=None if order_class is None else order_class.lower(),
+        qty=optional_decimal("qty"),
+        notional=optional_decimal("notional"),
+        filled_qty=optional_decimal("filled_qty"),
+        filled_avg_price=optional_decimal("filled_avg_price"),
+        limit_price=optional_decimal("limit_price"),
+        stop_price=optional_decimal("stop_price"),
+        trail_price=optional_decimal("trail_price"),
+        trail_percent=optional_decimal("trail_percent"),
+        hwm=optional_decimal("hwm"),
+        legs=legs,
+        created_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("created_at"), field="created_at"),
+        updated_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("updated_at"), field="updated_at"),
+        submitted_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("submitted_at"), field="submitted_at"),
+        filled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("filled_at"), field="filled_at"),
+        expired_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("expired_at"), field="expired_at"),
+        canceled_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("canceled_at"), field="canceled_at"),
+        failed_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("failed_at"), field="failed_at"),
+        replaced_at=_parse_timestamp(data.get("replaced_at"), field="replaced_at"),
+    )
+
+
+def _enum_string(value: str | Enum, *, field: str, allowed: frozenset[str]) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a string or enum")
+    normalized = raw.strip().lower()
+    if normalized not in allowed:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported {field}: {raw!r}")
+    return normalized

+class AlpacaOrderService:
+    """Synchronous order boundary over an injected Alpaca HTTP client."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: Any,
+        *,
+        persist_before_send: Callable[..., Any] | Any | None = None,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        for method in ("get", "post", "patch", "delete"):
+            if not callable(getattr(client, method, None)):
+                raise TypeError(f"client must expose {method}()")
+        resolved_environment = environment if environment is not None else getattr(client, "environment", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        if persist_before_send is not None:
+            candidate = getattr(persist_before_send, "persist_before_send", persist_before_send)
+            if not callable(candidate):
+                raise TypeError("persist_before_send must be callable or expose persist_before_send()")
+        self._client = client
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
+        self._persist_hook = persist_before_send
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def submit_order(
+        self,
+        *,
+        asset: AlpacaAsset,
+        side: str | Enum,
+        order_type: str | Enum,
+        sizing: OrderSizing | None = None,
+        qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
+        cycle_id: str,
+        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
+        attempt: int = 0,
+        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
+    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
+        """Submit a stock BUY/SELL market or limit order exactly once."""
+
+        self._require_live_authorization()
+        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
+        if sizing is not None and (qty is not None or notional is not None):
+            raise ValueError("pass sizing or qty/notional, not both")
+        resolved_sizing = sizing if sizing is not None else OrderSizing(qty=qty, notional=notional)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_sizing, OrderSizing):
+            raise TypeError("sizing must be an OrderSizing")
+        resolved_side = _enum_string(side, field="side", allowed=frozenset({"buy", "sell"}))
+        resolved_type = _enum_string(
+            order_type, field="order_type", allowed=frozenset({"market", "limit"})
+        )
+        tif = _enum_string(
+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        validated = self._validate_sizing(resolved_sizing, asset, tif=tif)
+        if resolved_type == "limit":
+            if limit_price is None:
+                raise ValueError("limit orders require limit_price")
+            price = quantize_price(limit_price, asset, strict=True)
+        else:
+            if limit_price is not None:
+                raise ValueError("market orders must not specify limit_price")
+            price = None
+        self._check_oversell(validated.qty, resolved_side, known_position_qty)
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "symbol": asset.symbol,
+            "side": resolved_side,
+            "type": resolved_type,
+            "time_in_force": tif,
+        }
+        if validated.qty is not None:
+            body["qty"] = str(validated.qty)
+        else:
+            body["notional"] = str(validated.notional)
+        if price is not None:
+            body["limit_price"] = str(price)
+        return self._submit(body, cycle_id=cycle_id, purpose=purpose, attempt=attempt)
+
+    def submit_stop_sell(
+        self,

+        asset: AlpacaAsset,

+            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
+        )
+        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
+        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
+        capability = f"standalone_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
+        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)

+    def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
+        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
+            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
+                return None
+            raise
+        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders/{id}")

+    def get_order_by_client_order_id(self, client_order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
+        cleaned = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
+        try:
+            data = self._client.get(
+                "/v2/orders:by_client_order_id",

+        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code

+    def list_open_orders(self, *, limit: int = 100, nested: bool = True) -> list[AlpacaOrder]:
